blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children younger than the stated age.
• This product contains small parts and a button battery. Keep it away from small children to prevent accidental swallowing. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not put fingers or other body parts into moving parts. They may be pinched and cause injury.
• Some electronic parts in this product contain magnets; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED lights. Doing so may cause nausea or other symptoms.
• Improper battery use can cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Follow the precautions below.
• If a button battery is swallowed or battery fluid gets into the eyes, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them out of children’s reach.
• Insert batteries with the correct polarity (+/−).
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire. When disposing of batteries, follow your local waste-disposal regulations.
• Do not use the product close to the ear. Accidental use near the ear may damage hearing.

blocks.translation:
• Precautions for use
• The battery installed in the Gaia Memory is for testing. Replace the battery when the sound becomes faint or the light weakens.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, dirty it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very hot or very cold places.
• Do not place this product on plastic sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not forcibly pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts in unnatural directions.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• The Gaia Memory cannot be attached to computers or similar devices. If it malfunctions, press the reset button.
• Because of the product's characteristics, appearance may vary. Please be aware of this in advance.
• If you store the Extreme Memory unit for a long time, store it unfolded the same way it is when packaged.
• Other infrared remotes, such as TV remotes, may cause false operation.
• The product may malfunction outdoors in direct sunlight. Play with it indoors.
• If it malfunctions, turn the power off and on again.
